plugins.name: ai-image-carousel-prompt-gen
plugins.description: Cinematic AI image prompt generator for social media carousel content. v3.0.1 Spotlight Portrait refinement: every slide sits on a BLUE BRAND GRADIENT base (navy #0A3D82 edges -> brighter #1E6FD0 center, never flat solid). The cover/hook + CTA are a calm, credible creator portrait (bald head + glasses) caught MID-ACTION (coffee mug / game controller / gesture, never a stiff stand) + 3+ floating topic UI elements (real tool cards/logos/screenshots); top-bar shows the visible @alisadikinma handle (no 'Bilingual' text); the brand icon is always bald + glasses, never haired. BODY/PEAK slides stay face-free hand-drawn doodle explainer cards on the same blue gradient. CTA is a Save+Comment+Share action variant. Refines the v3.0.0 Spotlight Portrait rebrand. v3.0.2: brand mark renders ONCE (top bar only, no duplicate centered watermark; single subtle @handle bottom-left) + opacity phrasing reworded so it no longer leaks into renders as a literal '30%' label. v3.0.3: entity-driven / acronym cover (Hybrid) — when the hook IS named entities or an acronym (FAANG, MANGOS, top-N model line-up), decoded company LOGOS render DOMINANT with the creator smaller/side; universal acronym-decode rule (expand to member-company logos on every act, never float bare letters); logos/wordmarks only, never a photoreal CEO face. v3.0.4: TEXT-OVERLAY PURITY hard rule — text zones render only their final literal copy (the subtitle is the headline's English translation, never font/grade words like 'condensed / soft artistry and depth'); the 'thirty percent opacity' prompt phrase no longer leaks as a literal '30%'/'Brand lox: 30%' (replaced with 'faint and barely-visible', brand mark top-bar-only + faint bottom-corner handle); CTA is exactly ONE mencolok command per slide (default SIMPAN/Save), never two stacked (no 'SIMPAN & BAGIKAN'). v3.0.5: locale_override wardrobe (a topic-defining country/culture drives the creator's attire) + hook-copy specificity + listicle-of-items archetype (competitor-product substitution). v3.0.6: People Spotlight — person-PROFILE body slides ('SIAPA <Name>?' / who-is, e.g. the 4 CURSOR MIT-dropout founders or Ashish Vaswani) now carry REAL faces for human touch instead of icon-only doodles. New optional slide-schema fields needs_real_faces + people[{name,role?}] + face_layout: the plugin detects a profile slide, emits the contract, reserves a clear photo band in the image_prompt, and never doodles/invents the person or bakes their name as on-image text — the consuming backend composites real cropped cut-outs into the reserved band.

plugins.name: article-content-writer

plugins.name: linkedin-post-writer
plugins.description: 4 skills + 1 agent for 2026-algorithm-optimized LinkedIn TEXT posts (1100-1300 chars). Single-shot orchestrator emits one OrchestratorOutput JSON per run with Depth Score validator (>=80 gate), 20-rule anti-slop rubric, 12 text hook formulas, link-in-comment discipline. Carousel format short-circuits to status=route_to_carousel_gen — backend dispatches the universal /carousel-gen engine (in ai-image-carousel-prompt-gen plugin) for slide + image-prompt authoring. v0.5.0 BREAKING: /linkedin-carousel skill DELETED (carousel design specs moved to /carousel-gen plugin). Pure content generation — emits draft JSON for an admin panel to consume.

plugins.name: social-short-form-writer
plugins.description: 2 skills for Instagram + TikTok caption authoring. /instagram-gen (4:5 photo carousel, 5-hashtag HARDCAP since Dec 2025, ≤125-char hook, NO link in caption — IG canonical) and /tiktok-gen (9:16 photo-mode, 5-8 hashtags, ≤100-char hook, first-100-char search-index gate, link-in-caption OK). English authoring (mirrors linkedin-post-writer v0.6.0 directive), Zod-validated discriminated-union output envelope, anti-AI-slop rubric. Pure content generation — emits one JSON envelope to stdout per run for backend ingestion. Pairs with linkedin-post-writer (long-form text + carousel routing) and ai-image-carousel-prompt-gen (universal slide image engine). Facebook Page caption authoring is intentionally OUT of scope — consuming backend reuses LinkedIn content (text format) or /instagram-gen output (carousel format).

plugins.name: ai-business-document-designer
plugins.description: Visual-first AI designer for business documents across 9 output types: VC pitch decks, B2B partnership decks, product brochures, personal portfolios, agency portfolios, product catalogs, service flyers, trifold leaflets, and hybrid decks. 5 skills + 1 agent + 25+ reference docs. 5-stage pipeline with 2 human approval gates: brief (discovery + output_type detection) → narrative/layout (story arc for decks OR modular page layout for print) → copywriting (per-page copy + pricing tier articulation) → gen (image prompts via GeminiGen.AI / Nano Banana Pro, Seedance 2.0 video, optional Remotion, HTML+CSS print stylesheet) → validate (dual rubric: deck mode 100pt or print mode 100pt). 8 framework files (deck-vc, deck-b2b, brochure-product, portfolio-personal, portfolio-agency, catalog-product, service-flyer, trifold-leaflet) + 7 named themes (indusia-tech, minimalist-editorial, industrial-brutalist, premium-luxe, pastel-soft, brutalist-mono, indo-tropical). Print-ready (CMYK + 3-5mm bleed + 300dpi + font embed). Indonesian-first (IDR, Bahasa, BI/OJK/ISPO/PPN 11%, named local comparables). Migrated from pitch-deck-designer 2026-05-21 with merged scope from print-collateral-designer.
